notes: Single source of truth. Engine reads this file; never hardcode metric definitions in code.

Scoring per metric: piecewise-linear map to 0-100 in the gold-bullish direction. For direction=lower_is_bullish: value<=bullish -> 100, value==neutral -> 50, value>=bearish -> 0, linear in between. For higher_is_bullish the order of thresholds is reversed (bearish < neutral < bullish).
Group score = weighted mean of member metric scores. Composite = sum(group_weight * group_score).

Transforms: level | chg_Nd (change over N trading days, same unit as level unless unit says bp) | chg_Nw (calendar weeks) | corr_Nd (rolling correlation of daily changes) | spread (a - b) | ratio | trailing_sum_Nm.
Every metric records source, last_updated, fallback_used, manual flags in history.json.
All thresholds are defaults to be tuned by the owner; changing them must not require code changes.

metrics.name: 5y TIPS real yield
metrics.why: Front end of the real curve; most sensitive to the expected Fed path.

metrics.name: 5y TIPS 60-day change
metrics.why: Direction of travel matters more than level for a regime bet.

metrics.name: 10y TIPS minus r*
metrics.why: Gap above neutral real rate = term/fiscal risk premium the market is charging.

metrics.name: 30y TIPS real yield
metrics.why: Long-end real rate; r>g check against ~2% trend real growth.

metrics.name: Real policy rate (EFFR - core PCE YoY)
metrics.why: Direct measure of financial repression at the short end where Treasury actually finances.

metrics.name: Implied fed funds change, next 6 months
metrics.why: Market-priced Fed path. Hikes priced = credibility = gold-bearish near term.

metrics.name: 10y breakeven inflation
metrics.why: Has sat in 2.2-2.5 since late 2022; a break above 2.75 is the anchor slipping.

metrics.name: 5y5y forward inflation expectation
metrics.why: Cleanest read of long-run anchor, strips out near-term energy shocks.

metrics.name: ACM 10y term premium
metrics.why: Term premium is the compensation the market demands for debasement risk.

metrics.name: 2s30s steepening, 20 days (bear-steepener when DGS30 also up)
metrics.condition: score only counts fully if DGS30 chg_20d > 0; otherwise cap at 50
metrics.why: Bear steepener = long end refusing to be repressed while short end is administered.

metrics.name: Broad dollar index, 60-day % change
metrics.why: External debasement channel.

metrics.name: Rolling 60d correlation: gold daily change vs DFII10 daily change
metrics.why: THE regime-flip signal. Normal regime is negative. Positive = market pricing hikes as unsustainable (fiscal dominance).

metrics.name: Bills as % of marketable debt
metrics.why: Activist Treasury issuance: the more the deficit is financed at the front end, the more hostage the interest bill is to the Fed.

metrics.name: Fed balance sheet, 13-week change
metrics.why: Pace of RMP / any re-expansion. Endogenous monetization made visible.

metrics.name: Treasury General Account, 4-week change
metrics.why: A large drawdown (e.g. to fund buybacks) is a one-off reserve injection.

metrics.name: SOFR minus IORB, 5-day average
metrics.why: Reserve scarcity signature; positive and rising means the Fed will have to inject.

metrics.name: ON RRP balance
metrics.why: Buffer that absorbs bill issuance without draining reserves; near zero = no buffer left.

metrics.name: Long-end buybacks accepted, trailing quarter
metrics.why: Actual duration removal by Treasury (announced max was ~$30bn for 9/9-11/4 window).

metrics.name: Avg tail of last 3 long-end auctions (10y/30y nominal + 10y/30y TIPS)
metrics.transform: avg of (high_yield - when_issued) for last 3 qualifying auctions
metrics.why: Tails and low bid-to-cover = long-end buyers' strike. Also record bid_to_cover as context.

metrics.name: Net interest outlays / receipts, trailing 12 months
metrics.why: The interest-cost spiral in one number.

metrics.name: Foreign official Treasury holdings, 12-month change
metrics.why: Reserve managers rotating out of Treasuries (into gold) shrinks the price-insensitive buyer base.

metrics.name: Central bank net gold purchases, trailing 3 months
metrics.why: The structural bid behind the de-dollarization premium.

crisis_flags.rule: crisis_flag = ON when at least 2 of the following are true (config.crisis_min_true, default 2)

conditions.note: 2008 signature: real yields spike while breakevens fall

fed_intervention_flags.rule: intervention_flag = ON when any one is true

conditions.note: Owner sets this with a date when the Fed announces purchases beyond RMP, an emergency facility, or yield targeting

context_series.transform: exp(a + b * DFII10) with (a, b) fit on 2006-01..2021-12
